1599504065318117376.a: Blindly attributing everything to a single, vast ancient civilization kinda blows over all the individual cultures and peoples descended from our ancestors. Trade and exploration likely brought many people in contact from far away at random.

1599504067251695616.a: I think people get the wrong impression of how inheritance works. You may feel that you're related to only a few people. Genealogy makes you realize you might have 65,000 direct ancestors, not even cousins, by ~300 years ago. From all over Earth. You are a blend of their stories.
